article.title: Countable vs. Uncountable Nouns
article.description: Countable nouns have a singular/plural form and can follow numbers: 'one apple, two apples.' Uncountable nouns have no plural and can't follow numbers directly: 'information' (not 'informations'), 'advice', 'furniture', 'water'. Use 'much' with uncountable nouns and 'many' with countable: 'How much water?' vs 'How many apples?'
article.content: Countable nouns have a singular/plural form and can follow numbers: 'one apple, two apples.' Uncountable nouns have no plural and can't follow numbers directly: 'information' (not 'informations'), 'advice', 'furniture', 'water'. Use 'much' with uncountable nouns and 'many' with countable: 'How much water?' vs 'How many apples?'

generated.script:
How much water, how many apples? Ye dono mein confusion hota hai na?

Dekho, simple hai. Countable nouns matlab jinhe hum count kar sakte hain. Jaise 'one apple, two apples'. Inki singular aur plural form hoti hai. But uncountable nouns ko hum count nahi kar sakte directly. Jaise information, advice, furniture, water. Inka koi plural nahi hota. Information ko 'informations' nahi bolte. To jab uncountable noun ho, use karo 'much'. Aur countable ke liye 'many'. Jaise 'How much water?' aur 'How many apples?'

Toh ab samjha na? Countable nouns ke saath 'many', aur uncountable ke saath 'much'. Simple!

Ye reel save kar lo future reference ke liye, aur follow karo The English Vault ko aise hi tips ke liye!

slides.body: Nouns are divided into countable and uncountable categories based on how we quantify them. Countable nouns have both singular and plural forms and can be preceded by numbers, like 'one apple' or 'two apples'. In contrast, uncountable nouns have no plural form and cannot be directly counted with numbers; examples include 'information', 'advice', 'furniture', and 'water'. Remember to use 'many' with countable nouns (e.g., 'How many apples?') and 'much' with uncountable nouns (e.g., 'How much water?').
slides.hindiSummary: जिन संज्ञाओं को गिना जा सकता है वे 'countable' होती हैं, जबकि जिन्हें नहीं गिना जा सकता वे 'uncountable' कहलाती हैं।
